correctness.rationale: All local PAVA Jacobians are contiguous-block arithmetic averaging matrices. Their exact discrete-gradient transfer rows are nonnegative, with maximum row sum n/2 and maximum column sum <=1. Weighted Holder proves all p bounds; 3-block strictly complementary ramp pairs attain the lower coefficient, 2-block pairs attain the exact p-infinity endpoint; p=1 follows from the column bound and identity chamber. A one-block face is zero. Exact rational independent step inputs validate the matrix formula across all partitions up to n=10; 2400 random two-input trials and strict witnesses through n=54 corroborate, but the proof covers all n and p.

value.rationale: A sharp and uniform exponent-dependent sensitivity phase change for a classical projection, with the leading constant 2^(1/p-1) and one-sample relative error bound, identifies an unavoidable polynomial instability for every p>1 despite BV contractivity at p=1. This is motivated by Sobolev-gradient perturbation robustness, not an arbitrary finite slice; strict pooled-block examples identify the mechanism.
